title: rDPS Meter
changeNote: 0.1.20 - two fixes from player reports, and the meter got faster. Your party's class colours and icons now survive closing and reopening the game: the run remembers who played it, so a restored breakdown comes back looking like the run it came from instead of a table of grey rows. And the Run History page now shows the numbers for runs that are already finished - picking a fight on an older run used to draw a meter of zeroes even though the breakdown was saved on disk. Runs you played before this update are included, colours and all, and the meter keeps many more of them around than it used to. On the performance side, the whole-run view was rebuilt from every fight in the run on every single frame, which made the meter slowest deep into a long run; it is now rebuilt only when the numbers actually move. Checked against game v0.109.1.
